contexts.text: Man () = the internal man. AC 158, Illustrated.
The men of the Most Ancient Church...
The Rational is represented by the man (in ).
By the man's eating () is signified that the Rational consented. AC 265.
To thy man thine obedience ()... By the man, here, as before, is signified the Rational, which (the Church) will obey...
The man () = the Lord, and also all the Celestial.
I have gotten a man Jehovah () = that with those who are called Cain, faith is Known and acknowledged as a thing by itself. AC 340. AC 429.
I have slain a man for my wound () = that he had extinguished faith. AC 429.
Man and wife () = the intellectual things of truth, and the voluntary things of good.
A male, or a man = the understanding, and the things which are of the understanding; thus the things which are of faith.
Hence so many laws concerning the prerogative of the man, and the obedience of the wife.

Of every clean beast thou shalt take to thee by sevens, the man and his wife; and of the beast which is not clean, by twos, the man and his wife ()... By the man and the wife is signified that truths were conjoined with goods. AC 718, Explained.
Man and wife is predicated of voluntary things, because by man and wife is represented a marriage. (See Male.)
Under Wife, see this reference.
And from the hand of man brother () = from all his Intellectual... The Intellectual with man is called man brother (References.) ... for the understanding is called man. References.
A tall man seen, (who) signified those called Noah...
They called themselves men and mighty ones from faith; for, in the Original Language, there is a word by which mighty one is expressed and at the same time man, which word is predicated of faith...
When, instead of husband, the term man is used, man = truth, and wife good. AC 2581:end. AC 4823:2, Explained.
Pharaoh commanded his men upon him () = that scientifics left the Lord... Men = intellectual things; and as they are here predicated of Pharaoh, or knowledge, men = things adapted thereto.
We are men brethren () = that in themselves they were united; (for) man brother = the union of truth and good.
A man from his brother () = disunion.
The men of Sodom were evil... ()... Men = intellectual and rational, here, scientific things, because they are predicated of the external man...

The will of man () = that which is contrary to faith from love or charity. This is what is signified by man... ( = persuasions of falsity. AC 5826:4.) ( = the intellectual proprium. AC 8409:3.) AC 9454. AC 10829:end. DLord 18:end. DLife 17:end. DP 298:3.
The portion of the men who went with me () = the Angels; (for) Angels... are called men.
Lo three men standing over him () = the Divine Itself, the Human Divine, and the proceeding Holy. AC 2156. AC 2218. AC 2245. AC 2319. AC 2320. AC 2352. AC 2365. AC 2373. AC 2397.
Who have not known a man () = that falsity has not contaminated them; for a man = rational truth; and, in the opposite sense, falsity.
They pressed upon the man () = that they wanted to inflict violence on truth. A man = what is intellectual and rational with man; thus truth.
The men who were at the door of the house () = the rational things and the derivative doctrinal things through which violence is offered to the good of charity.
The men said to Lot () = that the Lord admonishes those who are in the good of charity. The men = the Lord. AC 2411.
Man, in the Word, = truth; and wife, good.
No man in the earth () = that it is no longer known what truth is.
For when Abraham... is called a man, it = celestial truth.
Men = rational and scientific things, or intellectual things of all kinds.
Wives are affections of good... and men are thoughts of truth...
The legs of a man () = man's Own power of doing good.
The men of the city () = truths.
A man had not Known her () = pure from all falsity.
By a man, in the Word, is signified not only rational truths; but also, in the opposite sense, falsity...
A man = what is rational.
A man = truth. AC 3134, Illustrated. AC 3191.
Man, here, () = Divine truth natural.
Therefore the Lord is called the Bridegroom, the Man, the Husband...
A man knowing () is predicated of the affection of truth.
See Man.
As those in the Spiritual Church are treated of... it is said man and woman ().
A man to his brother () = those who are in the good of truth... A man = truth. AC 3654:2.
Men = truths.
Now my man will love me () = that thence is the good of truth... A man = truth.
A man = spiritual good, or the good of truth.
Men () = the rational truths which have been conjoined with good when it inflows into the Natural.

The men of the city () = those who are in the truths of doctrine... For when the inhabitants of a city are called the men of the city, it is not the good of doctrine, but its truths, which are signified.
These men are peaceable with us () = agreement as to doctrinal things. Men = truths, and therefore also doctrinal things...
A man = the truth of the Church.
A man of the field () = the good of life from doctrinal things. It is said a man, because by a man is signified the truth which is of the Church.
A man to his brother () = mutually. Explained. AC 5468. AC 8461. AC 9516.
The Midianites are called men because they = those in truth.

A man = one who is intelligent; and, in the abstract sense, truth, because the genuine Intellectual is from truths; but in the opposite sense, one who is not intelligent, consequently, falsity. AC 4818. AC 4823.
He asked the men of that place () = that truths were consulted.
An Egyptian man () = natural truth.
She cried to the men of the house () = the falsities of evil.
A man () = truth.
The man the lord () = the Celestial of the Spiritual. Man is predicated of what is spiritual, because man = truth.
As Joseph is here called the man (), he = the Spiritual, or truth inflowing from the Internal. AC 5591.
The men () = truths.
The man over Joseph's house () = that which is of the External Church; thus what is doctrinal.
Men of activity () = those more excellent in doctrine. For a man = one who is intelligent, and also truth, consequently doctrine.
They slew a man () = that they extinguished faith... A man = the truth of faith.
A man and his house came () = as to truth and as to good.
There went a man of the house of Levi () = the origin of truth from good. A man = truth.
The man () = the truth of good of that Church.
A man and woman = truth and good.
They did not see a man his brother () = that they did not perceive the truth of any good.
A man () relates to truth; and a woman to good.
From man and even to beast () = neither as to truth nor as to good.
For when men represent truth, their women represent good.
Women represent good, and men truth, when the Spiritual Church is treated of; but women represent truth, and men good, when the Celestial Church is treated of. AC 8338.
Choose for us men () = that he should draw up truths for the combat.
In the Spiritual Church the man represents truth, and the wife good.
A man to his companion = mutually.
To judge between a man and his companion () = disposition among truths.
Men of activity () = those who have strength from truths which are from good. ( = truths with which good can be conjoined). AC 8725.
Men of truth, hating gain () = because the truths are pure without a worldly end.
Whether beast or man, he shall not live () = that good and truth - would lose their spiritual life.
A man who does judgment () = those who are in truths from good.
A man = truth.

Such an affection (for truths and goods themselves) is general with good women; but the affection of the knowledges of truth is general with men... For it is according to Divine order that men should he in knowledges, but women only in affections... On this account scientifics and cognitions are represented by men, (Continued. See Female.)
He that smiteth a man, and he die () = the injuring of the truth of faith, and the consequent loss of spiritual life.

In Heaven they do not perceive a man, when he is mentioned in the Word; for a man is a person; but instead they perceive his faculty from which he is a man, namely, the intellectual faculty; and when they perceive this, they perceive the truth of faith. (Continued. See Man.)
To steal a man () = the application of the truth of faith to evil.
When men shall dispute () = contention in themselves about truths... Men = those who are intelligent, and who are in truths; and, in the abstract sense, intellectual things and truths.
A man (of the sons of Israel) = him who is of the Church, and is thence in spiritual truth, which is the truth of the doctrine of faith of the Church from the Word. AC 9041. AC 9058.
When men shall quarrel () = grievous contention among truths.
A man () = the internal man... For the truth of faith is in the internal man...
A man () = the truth of faith. AC 9073. AC 9090. AC 9149. AC 9182.

By the man clothed in linen (), in the supreme sense, is meant the Lord, and (therefore) the Divine truth which is from Him; for the Divine truth which is from the Lord is the Lord Himself in Heaven and the Church.
(A man of the First Earth). Described.
A man = its truth itself conjoined with good.
Men painted on the wall () = appearances of truth in externals.
The man clothed in linen was an Angel from Heaven.
The reason Moses is here called that man (), is that by a man, in the Word, is signified truth.
For a man = truth; and a man, the good of that truth.
A man = truth.
(The men of the Fifth Earth.) Described.

For a man is born to be intellectual; thus to think from the understanding... (For) a man acts from reason... and is harsher and less beautiful in the face, heavier in speech, and harder in body... Hence it is that in the Word by a youth and a man is meant the understanding of truth...
Both man and woman enjoy understanding and will; but still understanding predominates with the man, and will with the woman; and a man (homo)-is according to that which predominates.
See Man here.
I saw four men in shining garments and mitres...
There were present nine men...
These ten men with their Angel...

In a word, a man (there) is a man, and a woman a woman, in all the perfection of the form in which they have been created. Retire if you like, and examine yourself as to whether anything is wanting to prevent you from being a man as before.
With the men there all the nerves fall at the sight of a harlot, and are in tension at the sight of a wife.
Sometimes the man separates from the wife, and sometimes the wife from the man; and sometimes both from each other. Explained.
That then to the man is given a suitable wife... (Explained.)

There is the love of a man and a man, and also of a woman and a woman; and there is the love of a man for a woman, and the love of a woman for a man... The love of a man and a man is like the love of understanding and understanding. (Continued. See Love.)
Therefore two men with their reasonings fight like two wrestlers; and two women with their concupiscences sometimes come to blows like two pugilists.
Women were created by the Lord affections of the wisdom of the men... The second (of the wise ones) said that woman was created by the Lord through the wisdom of the man, because from the man...

The fourth said that the Lord has taken away beauty and elegance of life from the man, and has transcribed it into the woman; and that hence the man, without reunion with his beauty and elegance in the woman, is grim, austere, dry, and unlovable; and is not wise except to himself alone, and such a one is foolish: but when a man is united with his beauty and elegance of life in a wife, he becomes delightful, pleasant, lively, and lovable, and thus wise.
The Church is formed by the Lord with the man, and through the man with the wife... CL 125:2.
These men ran up to us...
For a man was born to be wisdom; and the woman to be the love of the wisdom of the man.

There are therefore two loves with the man, one of which, which is the prior one, is the love of being wise; and the other of which, which is the posterior one, is the love of wisdom. But if this latter love remains with the man, it is an evil love, and is called the conceit or love of his Own intelligence. That this love has been taken out of the man, lest it should destroy him, and has been transcribed into the woman, in order to become conjugial love... will be confirmed in what follows.
For the man cannot be loved from his form alone... but from the talent which is in him, which causes him to be a man (homo).
(The woman's domestic offices), which adjoin themselves to the offices of the men, which are called forensic.
For the men were created receptions of light = that is, of wisdom from the Lord; and the women were created receptions of heat, that is, of the love of the wisdom of the man from the Lord.
That the will of the wife conjoins itself with the understanding of the man, and thence the understanding of the man with the will of the wife. Explained.
That the inclination to unite the man to herself is constant and perpetual with the wife; but is inconstant and alternate with the man. Explained.
Women are born loves; but men... are receptions. CL 161:3.
For the man is not love; but only a recipient of love...
That conjunction is inspired into the man by the wife according to his love, and is received by the man according to his wisdom. General article.
For there is nothing of conjugial love, and not even of the love of the sex, with men; but solely with wives and women. (Shown by experiment.)

The reason the conjunction of the wife with the rational wisdom of the man is from within, is that this wisdom is proper to the understanding of the men, and climbs up into the light, in which women are not...
Because in very many men conjugial cold is deeply seated...
That this perception is the wisdom of the wife; and that it is not possible with the men; nor is the rational wisdom of the man possible with the wife. Explained.
Neither is the moral wisdom of the man possible with women in so far as it partakes of his rational wisdom.

That there are offices proper to the man, and offices proper to the wife; and that the wife cannot enter into the offices proper to the man, nor the man into the offices proper to the wife, and discharge them aright. General article.
In the offices proper to the men, understanding, thought, and wisdom play the leading part... (Continued. See Woman.)

The reason men cannot enter into the offices proper to women, and discharge them aright, is that they are not in the affections of women, which are altogether distinct from the affections of men. As the affections and perceptions of the male sex have been thus discriminated from creation... therefore among the statutes with the sons of Israel was this: There shall not be the garment of a man upon a woman, nor the garment of a woman upon a man; because this is an abomination (). The reason was, that in the Spiritual World all are clothed according to their affections; and the two affections cannot be united, except between two, and never in one.

That these changes (of state) are different with men from what they are with women; because men from creation are forms of knowledge, intelligence, and wisdom; and women are forms of the love of these things with men. Explained.

That with men there is an elevation of the mind into higher light; and that with women there is an elevation of the mind into higher heat; and that the woman feels the deliciousnesses of her heat in the man's light. Explained.
By the light into which men are elevated is meant intelligence and wisdom.
That with both men and women the states of life before marriage are different from what they are after marriage. Explained.
The man derives from the wife the lovely bloom of her love; and the wife from the man the bright resplendence of his wisdom...

She shall be called Ishah, because she was taken out of Ish, man ()... By the breast of the man is signified that essential and proper thing which is distinguished from the breast of the woman; which is wisdom...

(Thus) the woman was created out of the man by the transcription of his proper wisdom; that is, from natural truth; and the love of this was transferred from the man into the woman, in order that it might become conjugial love; and this was done that in the man there might not be the love of self but the love of his wife. (Continued. See Wife.)
The woman's being created while the man slept. Explained.
That this formation by the wife is effected through the conjunction of her own will with the internal will of the man. Explained.

With the man there are rational wisdom and moral wisdom, and the wife conjoins herself with those things which are of moral wisdom with the man... The things of rational wisdom make the man's understanding, and the things of moral wisdom make his will...

With the internal will of the man is said because the will of the man has its seat in his understanding; and the Intellectual of the man is the inmost of the woman... Men have an external will also, but this often partakes of simulation and dissimulation. This will the wife clearly sees; but she does not conjoin herself with it, except pretendedly or playfully.
The affections with men are in the understanding, but with women in the will.
The wife sees nothing more lovable than the man, and the man (nothing more lovable than the wife).
(The intelligence of women contrasted with that of men.) General article.
How much from their very birth the genius of men differs from that of women...
(Thus) the man is born understanding, and the woman love...
What would be the quality of the man's understanding without conjunction with feminine love...
That wives are in no excitation as men are... (Explained.)
That men have abundance according to the love of propagating the truths of wisdom, and according to the love of doing uses. General article.
Under Cold, see this reference.

They know that the men, from their nature, are unable to resist the obstinacy of their wives; and that after giving way they submit themselves... Because a man acts from the understanding, and a woman from the will; and the will can make itself obstinate, but not the understanding.
They added this admonition for the men: to leave their wives their own rights; and while they are in the alternate colds, not to account them as viler than their maidservants.
For every man who is only naturally rational and moral has cold towards his wife...

The reason choice belongs to the man, and not to the woman, is because the man is born to be understanding, and the woman to be love; and also because with men there is commonly the love of the sex; but with women the love of one of the sex; and also because it is not unbecoming for men to speak about love, and to publish it, whereas for women this is unbecoming... (Explained.)
That the man ought to court and entreat the woman to marry him, and not the woman the man. Explained.
Besides, men have not any innate love of the sex...
A sphere of love constantly flows forth from the wife, and a sphere of understanding from the man...
As the man from creation is truth, and the wife is the good thereof...
Whether a man who loves himself from his own intelligence can love his wife...
Virtue is not deficient when a man loves his wife from intelligence; but it is deficient if he loves her from insanity. Intelligence is to love the wife alone...
Therefore zeal has been implanted in the men; and, through the men, and for the sake of the men, in the women.
That jealousy with men and husbands is different from what it is with women and wives. Explained.

But with the spiritual the jealousy of the man is transferred into the wife, as the love of the wife is transferred into the man... But the jealousy of the wife is inspired into the man against the endeavours of the violating harlot...

The sphere of conjugial love is received by women, and through the women is transferred into the men; for the reason that the women have been born loves of the understanding of the men, and the understanding is a recipient. It is the like with the love of infants...
See Man.
A sign that understanding makes the man...
They say that they will have nothing to do with men... SE 3899.
Because the woman has been born the affection of truth and good, and the man the understanding of truth and good...
A man = the Church's truth itself conjoined with good. References.
If ye can find a man = whether there is any truth there.
The will of man = falsity from the voluntary proprium. ( = the love of falsity. AE 295:end.) ( = the falsities of faith. AE 329:30.) AE 745:end. AE 802:end.
By man is signified intelligence; and by man, wisdom. AE 400:4.
Man = truth.
The middle of a man () = the Intellectual where there was truth.
To smite a man = to reject all truth.
A man = Own intelligence.
A man = what is false.
No man passing through it () = no longer any truth, and thence not any intelligence.
A man = truth, and falsity.
Men = those who are in truths; women and children, those who are in goods.
In their anger they slew a man = that they have completely averted themselves from truths, and in their aversion have extinguished faith.
A man, in the Word, = truth and intelligence.
A man, in the Word, = the understanding of truth; and a man, the perception of good.
Man and woman () = truth and its affection.
Seven women shall take hold of one man () = that from affection they will desire and seek truth; but will not find it.
A woman shall compass a man () = that a new Church will be instaurated in which truth will be conjoined with its own affection.
Men = those who are in truths; women, those who are in good from the affection of truth. AE 555:13.
A man shall leave father and mother, and cleave to his wife = that truth must be of good.
Man and woman = the conjunction of truth and good. Illustrated. AE 652:28.
The form of a man = the appearance of truth.
A man and a brother = faith and charity. ( = truth and charity. AE 633:3.)
A man spirit ().
Man and inhabitants = all who are in truths and goods...
A man = intelligence.
Ten men () = all truths.

For a man is born to act from the understanding; but a woman from affection; and the understanding with men is the understanding of truth and good, and the affection with women is the affection of truth and good; and as all understanding draws its life from affection, they are coupled in Heaven as the affection is coupled with the corresponding thought...
That no truth of the Church will be left, is signified by, No man shall dwell there... ().
Man = the truth of the Church.

Man and brother = truth and good; and, in the opposite sense, falsity and evil. Man and companion = truths among themselves; and, in the opposite sense, falsities among themselves. AE 746:4. AE 746:6.
The woman's man () = the Rational.
Man and wife, in the Word, = the understanding of truth and the will of good; (and therefore also) the thought of truth and the affection of good; and also truth and good.
Therefore Cain was named a man of Jehovah; for by a man of Jehovah is signified the truth of Heaven and the Church.

The man was created to be the understanding of truth, and the woman to be the affection of good; consequently, the man to be truth, and the woman good. When the understanding of truth which is with the man, makes one with the affection of good which is with the woman, there is a conjunction of the two minds into one... AE 993:2. AE 998:4.
Then the wife is good in form, and the man is truth in form.

Inmost unition is like that of the soul and the heart; the soul of the wife is the man, and the heart of the man is the wife. The man communicates and conjoins his soul to his wife by actual love, and the wife receives it at heart. Hence the two are one... For it is from creation that all things of the man of both mind and body should have their Mutual in the mind and body of the wife...
The man is born to be understanding... thus truth.
For the man is born to be the understanding of truth; hence this predominates with him; and the woman is born to be the affection of good; hence this predominates with her... DWis 3.
The men dwell at one side of the city, and the women at the other...
The Intellectual (of the natural man separated from the spiritual) is signified by the man ().
